about: What a painting may not show of a place, read against what each painting shows (data/paintings/seen.json: its words, and the light, season and weather it was looked at for, CO-13): a place's own words (its name, the word its kind is named by, and what its description begins by saying it is: a shrine that is a well-head is no church, OR-30), its weather, the part of the day, and whether it is under the ground. A painting that shows what the place denies is not chosen for it (src/ui/fits.ts); where none of a kind's paintings fits, none is shown, a dim ground being better than a picture against the words (the owner, 7 November). A rule may forbid unless the painting shows something that answers it (a ruin painted as a ruin). Paintings against the text had come back in every cold round (R9-12, R10-08, R11-09, CP-01).
